query: 从数据库查询磷酸奥司他韦胶囊 2025 年各月的销售额，调用 run_code 在沙箱中 计算逐月环比增速，并用 matplotlib 生成一张柱状图，最后生成一份引用该图表的 销售分析 markdown 报告。

sources.title: SQL 查询记录
sources.url_or_ref: SELECT strftime('%m', sale_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS sales_amount FROM sales_records JOIN drugs ON sales_records.drug_id = drugs.drug_id WHERE drugs.generic_name = '磷酸奥司他韦胶囊' AND strftime('%Y', sale_date) = '2025' GROUP BY strftime('%m', sale_date) ORDER BY month

sources.title: SQL 查询记录
sources.url_or_ref:
WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (VALUES('01'),('02'),('03'),('04'),('05'),('06'),('07'),('08'),('09'),('10'),('11'),('12')),
drug_sales AS (SELECT strftime('%m', sale_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS sales_amount FROM sales_records JOIN drugs ON sales_records.drug_id = drugs.drug_id WHERE drugs.generic_name = '磷酸奥司他韦胶囊' AND strftime('%Y', sale_date) = '2025' GROUP BY strftime('%m', sale_date))
SELECT m.m AS month, COALESCE(ds.sales_amount, 0) AS sales_amount FROM months m LEFT JOIN drug_sales ds ON m.m = ds.month ORDER BY m.m
